name: Sasol George Highway
description_short: Convenient highway stop with hot meals, bakery items, and fuel between George and Victoria Bay.
description_long:
Located on the N2 between George and Victoria Bay, this Sasol service station offers more than just fuel. The on-site convenience store and bakery provide a practical stop for travelers along the Garden Route, with hot meals, fresh baked goods, and essential supplies available throughout the day.

It's a straightforward roadside option where you can grab a quick bite, fill up your tank, and use clean facilities before continuing your journey. The bakery counter offers fresh rolls, pies, and other grab-and-go items, while the convenience store stocks drinks, snacks, and basic groceries. A reliable stop for road trippers and locals alike who need a quick, no-fuss break along this scenic coastal stretch.
